name: Tenkousei 2
source:
Nice to meet you. I brought love.

Four people transfer to a new school and follow individual paths only to get together in grand finale.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2017/09/vn-of-month-april-1998.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
初次见面。我带来了爱情。

四个人转入一所新学校，各自踏上不同的道路，最后在宏大的结局中重新汇聚。

[摘自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2017/09/vn-of-month-april-1998.html]vndbreview[/url]]
